basic_profile.bio: Enthusiastic manga and anime fan hailing from Austin, Texas. With a background in graphic design, I often find myself drawing fan art inspired by my favorite series during my free time. I'm a night owl, frequently online after 9 PM until the early hours. Currently working as a freelance designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my passion for Japanese culture. Single and enjoying the freedom to explore various hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having grown up with a deep love for anime and manga, I have self-taught knowledge in Japanese culture and language to better understand the source material. My expertise comes from years of avid reading and participation in anime conventions, as well as engaging with online communities.
